[RTIM.8.1.1] A rule author's `.dstest` files carry the scenarios and their
expectations ([LTSL]). The compiler lowers them into the artefact
([RLOW.17.1]), and the `.dstest` interpreter ([RTIM.14]) runs them and reports
pass or fail per test case. The interpreter is a harness: it drives a runtime's
own engine through the operations an integrator has ([RTIM.14.1]), and it is
the one thing that executes the `Test*` and `Oracle*` atoms.
